title.fr: Évolution temporelle de la radioactivité (loi de décroissance)

sketch:
Observe: split view — SVG grid of N nuclei (each dies at a random
time drawn from Exp(λ) via a physics fork of useSeed) and SVG
polyline N(t) = N₀·exp(−λt) beside. Student sweeps T (demi-vie)
and N₀; live population + curve update. HUD reads T = ln2/λ.
Experiment: 3 seeded target curves; student tunes T, N₀. Evaluate:
grid killed, only sparse polyline data-points; numeric input
replaces slider; student submits T from graph. Wrinkle: RNG fork
discipline is critical — one fork for physics, one for target, one
for cosmetic α-particle sprites.
